summary: The puzzle panel beside a wide board (Numberlink, Sokoban) was a card headed "This puzzle", then the pack's place, then a two-line note about saving and sharing, so it read as a large sync card in an otherwise empty rail and added a heading's height on a phone. The pack's place ("Puzzle 2 of 5 in Linking practice") is now the panel's heading and the save status one quiet caption after it.
